workshop_summary: Outcome from initial sizing workshop: agreed baseline metrics and next-phase POC. Baseline steady-state target = 40–60 QPS (internal), production baseline observed at 120 QPS during replay, peak bursts to 200 QPS for short windows (5–15 minutes). Target latency SLOs: 95th <= 200–250ms for standard chat prompts (<= 128 tokens), p50 < 80ms. Token/sec observed per H100 estimate (with optimized kernels and batching profiles) ~28k tokens/sec under steady batch mixing; per-A100 estimate ~18k tokens/sec. Recommended reserved GPU plan: minimum dedicated pool sized for sustained baseline of 120 QPS and burst capacity to 200 QPS: suggested starting config 4x H100 (reserved) with autoscale burst to 6x H100 under peak policy, or 8x A100 as an alternate if pricing favors A100. Include 2x N+1 redundancy nodes for maintenance windows. Agreed to verify with on-prem inventory to consider a private deployment using customer-managed rack with Redwood private control plane. Action items: finalize SOW, run on-site micro-benchmarking with their preprocessing stack, add network egress SLAs and routing fallbacks (region-to-region).
